title: Youth programs whose required narrative report is recorded as not completed
question: Which programs did not complete a narrative report the department requires, and how much did they spend?
finding: 8 program-years across all service areas record a required mid-year or year-end narrative report as not completed: 6 in 2025-26, which spent $4.9 million. The largest: Community Youth Center of San Francisco - Coalition for Community Safety and Justice (2025-26, $1.1 million); Samoan Community Development Center - Pasifika Urban Roots (2025-26, $963,643); Young Community Developers - Summer Youth Academic and Employment Program (2025-26, $853,594).
how: Each program page's Performance Measure Results table: a row on a mid-year or year-end narrative report whose result reads 'Did Not Complete Report'.
limits: A report filed after the page was generated would still read as not completed; only some strategies require narrative reports. A missed report is a paperwork result, not a finding about services or money.
